ClusterTypeUpgrade.isDefer: Whether to execute during the maintenance window. Defaults to false. true: execute during the maintenance window; false: execute immediately.
ClusterTypeUpgrade.nodeType: Node specification. <li>Can be a new specification, which must be a Redis cluster edition specification. <li>Can be empty, defaulting to the original instance specification, but the original instance specification must be a cluster edition specification, otherwise execution fails.
ClusterTypeUpgrade.shardNum: Number of shards. <li>Can be set to a new number of shards; <li>Can be empty, defaulting to the original instance's shard count.
ClusterTypeUpgrade.replicationInfo: Replica information. <li>Reducing replicas is not supported; adding is allowed. <li>Can be set to new replica information, which must be the full replica information. <li>Can be empty, defaulting to the original instance's replica count.
ClusterTypeUpgrade.replicationInfo.availabilityZone: You can query the availability zone list by calling the get availability zone list API. The zoneName naming convention is "country-region-availability zone sequence" in lowercase, e.g., Beijing availability zone A is "cn-bj-a".
ClusterTypeUpgrade.replicationInfo.isMaster: Whether it is the master node. 1 for master, 0 for slave. There is one and only one master node.
